question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Jane Eyre, Bob gets Ivanhoe, Claire gets Candide, Dave gets Walden, and Eve gets The Hobbit.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Dave and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Dave swap books. Then, Claire and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Dave swap books. Finally, Eve and Bob swap books. At the end of the semester, Eve has
Options:
(A) Jane Eyre
(B) Ivanhoe
(C) Candide
(D) Walden
(E) The Hobbit
solution:
Each row lists books in the order Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Candide | Walden | The Hobbit
1. Dave ↔ Bob: Jane Eyre | Walden | Candide | Ivanhoe | The Hobbit
2. Bob ↔ Dave: Jane Eyre | Ivanhoe | Candide | Walden | The Hobbit
3. Claire ↔ Bob: Jane Eyre | Candide | Ivanhoe | Walden | The Hobbit
4. Bob ↔ Dave: Jane Eyre | Walden | Ivanhoe | Candide | The Hobbit
5. Eve ↔ Bob: Jane Eyre | The Hobbit | Ivanhoe | Candide | Walden
Eve has Walden, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
